services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: Summer is one of the most important seasons in a young athlete's development. With school out and schedules freed up, it's the perfect window to make real, lasting progress in a sport - and few sports offer the cognitive, physical, and social rewards of table tennis. Whether your child has never touched a paddle or is already competing at a high level, a structured summer camp can be a game-changer. At the Houston International Table Tennis Academy (HITTA), Houston's premier table tennis training facility, summer camps are designed to meet players exactly where they are - and push them to the next level.
